rationale: Decision: resubmit the measured iteration-8 design unchanged. I accept the critique's point that the kd 0.1 to 0.05 comparison (iteration 6) also changed line_loss, so it does not show that kd has a real effect. I therefore drop my earlier claim about kd. I still reject the critique's suggestion to test start handling or recovery after the first line loss, because this is the final iteration and the unseen-track score depends on a measured, robust design rather than a new untested change. I also correct an error in the authorised input: entity1 lists ki 1.0, but the outcome record for iteration 8 (the 50.39 run) shows ki 0.4. Iteration 10 changed only kd (0.1 to 0.15, ki kept at 0.4) and scored 49.78, so the measured design that scored 50.39 is ki 0.4, kd 0.1. I use ki 0.4, so the submitted design matches the race that produced the best score. Expected result: a development score near 50.4, failing at the first line-loss event on each track. Completion within 3 s is unlikely.
